title: A Path Across Hell, and Towards Any Beyond
survival_class: Changing Safety. / Unpredictable Security. / Fluctuating Entity Count.
physical_identity: A flat, wool-textured cloud plane reached by a concrete office stairwell; zones grade from white to grey to black storm.
scale_topology: Extremely large; zones at ~30 km and ~80 km, storm edge 15 km further; flat plane with an elevator-house-like starting room.
anomalies: Entities drift outward from the epicentre
lighting_sound: Cloud light; grey and black skies in outer zones; cold breeze, gales up to 29-31 m/s, torrential rain; sound beyond weather not stated.

entities.behavior: Seen in the grey zone; not outwardly hostile; proposed sightings in the black zone.

entities.name: Dullers
entities.behavior: Seen in the grey zone; not outwardly hostile.

entities.name: Entity-17-infected humanoids and non-humanoids
entities.behavior: Wander outward; do little more than move.

entities.name: Woodlins
entities.behavior: Seen in the grey zone; wander outward.

entities.behavior: Proposed sightings in the black zone; possible attackers.

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Smilers, Dullers, entity-17-infected creatures, Woodlins (reported); animalistic types rumoured

entrances.from: Any of the 203 listed levels (text claims 208), plus named places

entrances.conditions: identical in every source level; same arrival location for all
entrances.quote: a white, metal double door that resembles those of lifts or elevators

exits.method: walk outward across the cloud plane through the grey and black zones and the storm
exits.conditions: destination never known; hypotheses are not documented
exits.risk: death in the lethal storm (hypothesis B), equipment failure

signature_mechanic: A one-way pilgrimage across zoned cloud terrain toward an unknown beyond; the storm wall is the end.
verticality: Eight flights of stairs at the start; otherwise flat.
do_not: Do not build a destination beyond the storm; the page says it is unknown.
Do not make entities hostile packs; they ignore wanderers unless provoked.
Do not populate the plane with landmarks or structures.
Do not depict suicide methods or gore; keep an end-state abstract with a content warning.
Do not change the arrival: it is always the stairwell base, never on the plane.
Do not treat hypotheses A and B as article-level fact; both are stated as ideas.
Do not tie the level to a specific entrance origin list beyond the white double door.
conflicts_notes: Entrance count: text says 208, list has 203. Footnotes absent. 'Crawlers' and 'entity-17' link to the same slug (/entity-17).
